name: AtomS3R Intercom
description: Intercom firmware for M5Stack AtomS3R + Atomic Voice Base using ESP-NOW and/or Wi-Fi. Supports mixed networks of multiple StickS3 and AtomS3R units, browser peers over HTTPS, peer selection, spy mode, and live/clip audio. Wi-Fi and ESP-NOW-only units can communicate together.
keywords: ESP32-S3, M5Stack, AtomS3R, Intercom, ESP-NOW, LittleFS
author: Robot-icist
